title: This Monthly Habit Can Save You Time Updating Your Resume
description:
This monthly habit can change the way you write your resume. Taking notes about your work wins throughout the year is a great way to alleviate the stress of trying to remember everything when you finally DO go to update your resume. 3 ways to efficiently do this is by 1) using the Teal Resume Builder and the Achievement Assistant Tool 2) Keeping a running list on Google Docs 3) Keeping a similar list on Notion. #resumetips #jobsearchtips #jobsearching #careeradvice #careergrowth
